seo.heading: Cosmic Signature Protocol Statistics
seo.description: Explore Cosmic Signature activity on Arbitrum: Performance Cycles, gestures, NFTs, CST, anchoring, reserves, and allocations. The tables below show the latest available protocol data.
seo.unavailableSuffix: . Live data is temporarily unavailable; this page is showing explanatory protocol context.
seo.dataSource: Data comes from the public Cosmic Signature API, which indexes the protocol’s Arbitrum smart contract activity. The links below explain the protocol and its verification resources.

activePerformanceCycle.label: Active Performance Cycle
activePerformanceCycle.tooltip: The current Performance Cycle number indexed by the public Cosmic Signature API.
activePerformanceCycle.seoDescription: Current Performance Cycle number indexed from Cosmic Signature activity on Arbitrum.

activeCycleGestures.label: Active Cycle Gestures
activeCycleGestures.tooltip: Number of indexed gestures made in the active Performance Cycle so far.
activeCycleGestures.seoDescription: Indexed gesture count for the active Performance Cycle.

totalCycles.label: Total Cycles
totalCycles.tooltip: Total Performance Cycles completed or currently indexed since protocol launch.

allocationsDistributed.label: Allocations Distributed
allocationsDistributed.tooltip: Indexed allocation records across all cycles. Includes recipient allocations and protocol allocation markers such as Anchor Distribution deposits.

cosmicSignatureNftsImprinted.label: Cosmic Signature NFTs Imprinted
cosmicSignatureNftsImprinted.tooltip: Cumulative count of Cosmic Signature NFT ERC-721 tokens imprinted by the protocol across all indexed cycles. A value of 0 means the statistics API is currently reporting no indexed imprints for this counter.
cosmicSignatureNftsImprinted.seoDescription: Cumulative Cosmic Signature NFT ERC-721 tokens imprinted by the protocol across all indexed cycles.

contractBalance.label: Contract Balance
contractBalance.tooltip: ETH currently held by the Cosmic Signature protocol contract before future allocations, retrievals, or cycle transitions.
contractBalance.seoDescription: ETH currently held by the Cosmic Signature protocol contract before future allocation flows.

numAllocationsDistributed.label: Allocations Distributed
numAllocationsDistributed.tooltip: Number of indexed allocation records. Aggregated recipient totals are used when detailed records are unavailable.

totalSignatureAllocationsDistributed.label: Total Signature Allocations Distributed
totalSignatureAllocationsDistributed.tooltip: Total ETH distributed through Signature Allocations across indexed cycles.

stellarSelectionEthDeposited.label: Stellar Selection ETH Deposited
stellarSelectionEthDeposited.tooltip: Total ETH allocated into Stellar Selection pools across indexed Performance Cycles.

stellarSelectionEthRetrieved.label: Stellar Selection ETH Retrieved
stellarSelectionEthRetrieved.tooltip: Total ETH retrieved by selected recipients from Stellar Selection pools.

totalSupplyErc20.label: Total Supply (ERC-20)
totalSupplyErc20.tooltip: Current total supply of CST tokens, the ERC-20 token used for participation and coordination.

totalCstConsumed.label: Total CST Consumed
totalCstConsumed.tooltip: Cumulative CST spent by participants when making CST gestures.

cstConsumedCurrentCycle.label: CST Consumed This Cycle
cstConsumedCurrentCycle.tooltip: CST spent by participants making CST gestures during the active Performance Cycle so far.

ethInGesturesCurrentCycle.label: ETH in Gestures This Cycle
ethInGesturesCurrentCycle.tooltip: Total ETH paid by participants in ETH gestures during the active Performance Cycle so far.

cstGestures.label: Gestures with CST
cstGestures.tooltip: Number of gestures made with CST instead of ETH across indexed cycles.

outreachReserve.label: Outreach Reserve

outreachTransactions.label: Outreach Transactions
outreachTransactions.tooltip: Number of indexed Outreach Reserve distribution transactions.

randomWalkNftsUsed.label: Random Walk NFTs Used
randomWalkNftsUsed.tooltip: Random Walk NFTs already attached to ETH gestures for a one-time Gesture Cost reduction.

namedTokens.label: Named Tokens
namedTokens.tooltip: Cosmic Signature NFTs that currently have a custom owner-assigned name.

uniqueParticipants.label: Unique Participants

attachedNfts.label: Attached NFTs

sectionTooltips.attachedAssets: ERC-721 and ERC-20 assets attached to gestures, viewable for all cycles or only the current Performance Cycle.
sectionTooltips.gestureTypeDistribution: Share of gestures made with ETH, Random Walk (ETH-paid), and CST over time, sampled at a chosen interval. Current cycle only.
sectionTooltips.enduranceTimeline: A Gantt of who held the lead during a cycle. Each bar is a lead stint (its width = how long that address held the lead). The widest bar is the Endurance Champion; the Chrono-Warrior is the participant whose single continuous reign as Endurance Champion lasted the longest. Pick any cycle to compare.
sectionTooltips.cstWindow: How the CST Calibration Window evolved during a cycle. Every ETH gesture shortens the window slightly; every CST gesture lengthens it. The window sets how fast the CST gesture cost decays to free. Pick any cycle to compare.
sectionTooltips.cstCost: What each CST gesture actually cost during a cycle, on a log scale, alongside the allocation clock remaining right before it. Mid-cycle gestures are often nearly free; in the endgame, rapid gesturing leaves the cost no time to descend and prices can reach thousands of CST.
sectionTooltips.attachedTokenDistribution: Contracts and token counts for ERC-721 assets attached to gestures.
sectionTooltips.cosmicSignatureTokenDistribution: Current owner distribution for Cosmic Signature NFT ERC-721 tokens.
sectionTooltips.cstBalanceDistribution: Current wallet distribution for CST ERC-20 balances.
sectionTooltips.cstTotalSupply: Historical CST ERC-20 supply changes, including imprints and consumption over time.
sectionTooltips.cycleActivations: System event windows that show when protocol cycles or modes became active and ended.
sectionTooltips.uniqueParticipants: Wallets with at least one indexed gesture, sorted by gesture count.
sectionTooltips.uniqueRecipients: Wallets that received indexed protocol allocations.
sectionTooltips.uniqueEthContributors: Wallets that contributed ETH to the protocol.
sectionTooltips.anchorReleaseActions: Chronological anchor and release actions for the selected NFT type.
sectionTooltips.anchoredTokens: Tokens currently anchored in the selected anchoring wallet.
sectionTooltips.uniqueAnchorHolders: Wallets that have anchored or released the selected NFT type.
sectionTooltips.gestureFrequency: Indexed gesture counts grouped over time to show protocol activity patterns.
sectionTooltips.gestureSpikes: Periods where gesture activity changed quickly compared with surrounding activity.
sectionTooltips.participantActivePeriods: The longest indexed active participation windows for the most active wallets.

anchoringTooltips.cstActiveAnchorHolders: Wallets currently anchoring at least one Cosmic Signature NFT.
anchoringTooltips.cstAnchorDistributionDeposits: Total deposit events into the Cosmic Signature NFT Anchor Distribution pool.
anchoringTooltips.cstTotalAnchorDistributions: Total ETH distributed as Anchor Distributions to Cosmic Signature NFT anchor-holders.
anchoringTooltips.cstTotalTokensAnchored: Number of Cosmic Signature NFTs currently anchored in the protocol.
anchoringTooltips.cstUnretrievedAnchorDistributions: Anchor Distributions allocated but not yet retrieved by Cosmic Signature NFT anchor-holders.
anchoringTooltips.rwlkActiveAnchorHolders: Wallets currently anchoring at least one Random Walk NFT.
anchoringTooltips.rwlkTotalTokensImprinted: Total Cosmic Signature NFTs and paired CST imprinted for Random Walk NFT anchor-holders through Anchored-NFT Stellar Selection.
anchoringTooltips.rwlkTotalTokensAnchored: Number of Random Walk NFTs currently anchored in the protocol.
anchoringTooltips.cstGroup: Cosmic Signature NFT anchoring shares ETH Anchor Distributions among currently anchored Cosmic Signature NFTs.
anchoringTooltips.rwlkGroup: Random Walk NFT anchoring provides eligibility for Anchored-NFT Stellar Selection allocations.

typeRatio.notStarted: The current cycle hasn’t started yet.

typeRatio.empty: No gesture activity in the current cycle yet.
typeRatio.description: Each sample is the gesture-type mix within that window (per-interval, not cumulative). Windows with no gestures show 0% for all types.

endurance.description: Each bar is a lead stint — an address holding the lead from one gesture until the next gesture arrives. Bar width is how long they held the lead. Amber-outlined bars set a new endurance record at the time; the violet bar is the single longest hold of all (Endurance Champion); the rose lane held the title longest overall (Chrono-Warrior). Hover a bar for details.

cstWindow.description: The CST Calibration Window sets how long a CST gesture's cost takes to descend from its starting value to free. Every ETH gesture shortens the window slightly; every CST gesture lengthens it. Each dot is a gesture, colored by type; the line is the window in effect after it.
cstWindow.empty: No per-gesture Calibration Window data for this cycle. Cycles indexed before the V2 events do not include it.
cstWindow.loadErrorTitle: Failed to load Calibration Window timeline
cstWindow.loadErrorMessage: Could not fetch the gesture history for this cycle.

cstCost.clickHint: Click the dot to open the transaction.
cstCost.description: Each violet dot is the CST actually paid for a gesture (log scale — hollow dots were free). After every CST gesture the cost resets near twice the paid amount and descends to free across the Calibration Window. The dashed rose line shows the allocation clock remaining right before each gesture: when the clock runs low, rapid gesturing leaves the cost no time to descend, so paid prices escalate. Click a dot to open its transaction.

attachedNfts.subtitle: NFTs attached to gestures by community members across cycles
attachedNfts.description: Community members can attach their NFTs (ERC-721) to gestures using the advanced options. Attached NFTs forward to the participant who receives the Signature Allocation when the cycle finalizes, enriching the distribution beyond ETH.

usedRwlkNfts.title: Used Random Walk NFTs
usedRwlkNfts.subtitle: Random Walk NFTs attached to ETH gestures for the one-time 50% Gesture Cost reduction
usedRwlkNfts.description: Random Walk NFT holders can attach an unused NFT to an ETH gesture for a 50% Gesture Cost reduction in Cosmic Signature. Once used, a Random Walk NFT is recorded here. Each NFT can only be used once for this discount, making the timing of its use a strategic decision.
